reason: My developer is away for two weeks and I have a grant client who needs the form wired into their CRM now, so a free first task under NDA costs me nothing to try. If that lands on time I would pay for one more small one, not more, because at 400-1,000 EUR per site I cannot bury 600 EUR of subcontracting in a project.
objection: He has a day job and takes two tasks at a time; if his Oracle work spikes or he is simply full, I am the one standing in front of the client with a broken integration under my name, and I have already been burned by a freelancer a week before a deadline.
would_change_my_mind: A written penalty or refund if the deadline slips, and a named backup person who picks up the task when he is unavailable, so the risk is his and not mine.
